//: Deployment overrides for IIS. Loaded automatically when ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Production.
Python:Directory is relative to the application folder, not the process working
directory -- the host under IIS does not set the working directory to the app folder,
so a bare relative path would resolve somewhere else entirely.
Python:Venv must be a real virtual environment on THIS machine with a pyvenv.cfg
whose `home` points at a Python 3.14 install that exists here. A venv is not
relocatable; copying one from a developer machine works only if the base install
is at the identical absolute path. Create one on the server and install the
OPSLOOKUP_DATA_DIR is read by host.py at import time, so it has to be set before the
interpreter starts. PythonBridge.ApplyDataDirectory does that itself, falling through
%ProgramData%\AI.TicketingAssistant\data then %TEMP%, and probes each candidate by
writing to it. Set it here as DataRoot only to override that choice -- for example to
point at a disk that is not the system one.
Do NOT put secrets in this file. deploy.ps1 places them in app-pool environment
variables first and writes them here only if that fails, so on a correctly deployed
machine this file holds none. Note also that <environmentVariables> in web.config is
